description: Source code for EGLConsumer class managing EGL images and texture binding for SurfaceTexture in Android graphics framework.

classes.name: EGLConsumer
classes.description: Manages EGL images and texture binding for SurfaceTexture, including synchronization and buffer management.

classes.name: EGLConsumer::EglImage
classes.description: Represents an EGL image created from a GraphicBuffer, handles creation, binding, and destruction of EGL images.

methods.name: updateTexImage
methods.description: Updates the texture image from the buffer queue, binding new buffers to the GL texture.

methods.name: releaseTexImage
methods.description: Releases the current texture image, unbinding buffers and resetting state.

methods.name: attachToContext
methods.description: Attaches the EGLConsumer to a GL context and binds the texture.

methods.name: detachFromContext
methods.description: Detaches the EGLConsumer from the current GL context, releasing resources.

methods.name: checkAndUpdateEglStateLocked
methods.description: Checks and updates the current EGL display and context state.

methods.name: syncForReleaseLocked
methods.description: Creates synchronization fences for buffer release operations.

methods.name: doGLFenceWaitLocked
methods.description: Waits for the GL fence to ensure buffer access completion.

methods.name: onFreeBufferLocked
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a buffer slot is freed.

methods.name: onAbandonLocked
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the EGLConsumer is abandoned.

methods.name: EglImage::createIfNeeded
methods.description: Creates an EGL image from the associated GraphicBuffer if needed.

methods.name: EglImage::bindToTextureTarget
methods.description: Binds the EGL image to a specified GL texture target.

methods.name: EglImage::createImage
methods.description: Creates an EGL image from a GraphicBuffer with appropriate attributes.
